{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Straight-leg trousers, full length, charcoal grey (#4A4D52), fine wool-blend twill

Fitted blouse with a soft collar, hip length, long sleeves, muted ivory (#EDE6D8), matte crepe

Textured blazer, single-breasted, hip length, slightly tailored, warm taupe-grey (#8C857B), wool bouclé-weave tweed

Loafers, low block heel, closed toe, deep chocolate brown (#4B3A32), smooth leather

Belt, slim, polished small buckle, deep chocolate brown (#4B3A32), smooth leather

Shoulder bag, structured medium size, dark taupe (#6B5F55), grained leather

Small stud earrings, brushed silver (#B8B8BA), metal

This outfit suits a restrained office day in autumn: every colour is muted and neutral, so nothing bright appears, in line with her wish. The blouse, trousers and textured blazer follow the neat business level, while the loafers keep it polished yet comfortable for a full day at work. The blazer adds warmth for the cool season and its texture gives depth without drawing attention. Matching the belt and shoes in one brown, with just one small metallic accent in the earrings, keeps the whole look calm and put together."}
